name: 泥潭II
group_note: 泥潭II (Mud Swamp II) -- same ES2/Annihilator architecture family as nte (泥潭二), and every file this pass touched (logind.lpc, named.lpc, versiond.lpc, dns_master.lpc, clone/user/user.lpc) was confirmed byte-identical to nte's pre-fix versions -- not a full-lib duplicate (10731 of ~14-16k files differ overall, mostly game content), but this specific set of infrastructure files is shared verbatim. Copied nte's already-verified fixed files directly rather than re-deriving the same patches: is_chinese() GBK byte-range fix, check_legal_name()'s unhalved length bounds (2 call sites + combined-name check) in logind.lpc, named.lpc's invalid_new_name() empty-name bound, the uptime()<30 loopback bypass, §7.52 socket-daemon gutting on both dns_master.lpc (wholesale) and versiond.lpc (selective -- 13 socket-touching functions gutted, ~32-caller non-socket public interface like is_version_ok()/query() left intact), and user.lpc's accept_kill() is_killing() object/string mismatch (§7.50). Verified independently via live WASM registration on this lib specifically: full registration flow completes with zero compile errors, look/quit verified (including quit's new-account deletion-confirmation flow), and the wizlist admin id (fluffos) registered fresh and correctly routed to the wizard-only start room. Full flow verified before and after the LPC formatter pass; formatter introduced no corruption (all 3 blind-spot checks clean -- same two large-diff outliers as nte, both already confirmed non-corrupted: versiond.lpc's own gutting, combatd.lpc's legitimate if-else-if message-ladder collapsing). Same in-universe birth-ritual content gate as nte/nt6 affects score for a freshly registered character -- not a bug.
